analogy.rationale: PARP inhibitors trap PARP on DNA and block repair of single-strand breaks, producing DNA damage and replication stress that overlaps with other DNA-damaging and replication-blocking classes. The strongest transcriptional similarity should be to DNA alkylating agents and topoisomerase inhibitors, which also generate DNA lesions and activate damage-response programs.
